verdict.rationale: SavvyCal offers a documented REST API with OAuth2/PAT/bearer auth, JSON responses, webhooks with HMAC signature verification, and a JS embed library, with a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec confirmed at runtime (17 paths). This provides a clear, documented public API surface for programmatic/agentic access. Missing for 10: no llms.txt or discoverable OpenAPI at conventional paths (404s), and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
